subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Whistleblower Protections in AML
description: A quick, practical guide to Whistleblower Protections in AML.

hook.text: You discover your bank is laundering money. Report it and risk your career. Stay silent and become complicit.

buildup.text: AML whistleblower protections vary wildly. In the US, Dodd-Frank offers financial rewards for tips.

discovery.text: The SEC has paid over $2 billion in whistleblower awards since 2012. One person received $279 million.

twist.text: In many countries, whistleblowers still face retaliation, blacklisting, and legal threats from their employers.

climax.text: Strong whistleblower programs turn insiders into the most effective AML enforcement tool available.

punchline.text: Report the crime. Risk your career. Maybe get $279 million.

quiz.question: How much has the SEC paid in whistleblower awards since 2012?
